This pristine vehicle boasts a striking White exterior that exudes elegance and sophistication. The smooth lines and bold stance of the GLE 350 are complemented by a series of eye-catching design elements, including the signature Mercedes-Benz grille, LED headlamps, and dynamic body contours. The SUV sits on stylish alloy wheels that not only enhance its aesthetic appeal but also contribute to its overall performance and handling. Step inside, and you will be greeted by a meticulously crafted Black interior that embodies luxury and comfort. The cabin is spacious and thoughtfully designed to provide an inviting atmosphere for both the driver and passengers. Premium materials, including high-quality leather upholstery, wood trim, and soft-touch surfaces, create an upscale environment. The GLE 350 is equipped with a wealth of factory default features that elevate the driving experience. The centerpiece of the interior is the high-resolution 12.3-inch touchscreen display, which serves as the hub for the Mercedes-Benz User Experience (MBUX) infotainment system. This intuitive system allows for seamless access to navigation, audio, and communication features. Voice recognition technology enables you to control various functions effortlessly, ensuring that your focus remains on the road ahead. For your entertainment needs, the GLE 350 comes with a premium audio system that delivers crisp sound quality, allowing you to enjoy your favorite music and podcasts during your travels. Additionally, Bluetooth connectivity and smartphone integration via Apple CarPlay and Android Auto make it easy to stay connected and entertained on the go. Safety is a top priority in the GLE 350, and this model is equipped with a comprehensive suite of advanced safety features. The Mercedes-Benz Intelligent Drive system includes Active Brake Assist, Blind Spot Assist, and Lane Keeping Assist, all designed to enhance your awareness and provide added peace of mind on the road. The vehicle also features a rearview camera, ensuring that parking and reversing are hassle-free. With less than 16,000 miles on the odometer, this GLE 350 averages fewer than 6,000 miles per year, reflecting its excellent condition and low usage. The fuel efficiency is commendable, achieving 20 MPG in the city and 25 MPG on the highway, making it an ideal choice for both daily commutes and long-distance trips. This vehicle comes with a clean CARFAX report, indicating its well-maintained history with only one previous owner. The GLE 350 has been treated with care and is in excellent overall condition, both mechanically and aesthetically. In summary, the 2023 Mercedes-Benz GLE 350 is a perfect blend of luxury, performance, and technology, making it an outstanding choice for those seeking a versatile and sophisticated SUV. With its powerful turbocharged engine, elegant White exterior, and luxurious Black interior, this vehicle is designed to impress. Experience the refinement and capability of the GLE 350 for yourself and drive away in a vehicle that truly embodies the essence of the Mercedes-Benz brand.

The sophisticated exterior finish is complemented by performance focused details such as the carbon fiber exterior sill plate, enhancing both visual appeal and lightweight construction. The sculpted lines of the 488 Spider, combined with its retractable hardtop, create a dramatic presence whether cruising city streets or carving canyon roads.


Inside, the cabin reflects Ferraris dedication to craftsmanship and motorsport heritage. The carbon fiber driver zone with LEDs integrates shift lights and essential controls into the steering wheel, placing race inspired technology directly at your fingertips. A carbon fiber upper tunnel further enhances the cockpits performance aesthetic. The striking Goldrake racing seats in carbon fiber provide exceptional support while reducing weight, delivering both comfort and track ready capability. Accelerating from 0 to 60 mph in just 3.0 seconds, this Ferrari delivers explosive acceleration, razor sharp steering response, and an unmistakable exhaust note. The mid engine layout ensures superb balance and agility, making every drive a thrilling experience.

Beyond its performance credentials, the GTC Speed delivers exceptional craftsmanship and comfort expected of Bentley's Mulliner level specification, including premium Beluga leather with contrast stitching, heated and ventilated power seats with memory, neck warming Air Scarf system for open top motoring, and rich hand finished wood or metal veneers throughout the cabin. Important features include large ventilated disc brakes with strong stopping power, advanced climate control, premium audio, and a power operated soft top roof that stows and deploys quickly while maintaining excellent refinement. The result is a convertible that not only excels at long distance touring with effortless high speed capability, but also provides a richly appointed and serene interior environment, making this GTC Speed W12 a truly versatile grand tourer with both performance and luxury in abundance. This can help minimize driver fatigue and improve overall fuel economy. Resting your right foot is right at your fingertips thanks to cruise control with steering wheel mounted controls.

By remotely opening and closing, power trunk lets you skip straight to the loading. Then you can walk away as it gently closes and latches. Load and go with power open and close trunk.
Safety and Security

It uses the speed of the brake pedal's travel to sense panic braking, then applies all available power to boost your stopping power. Brake assist can stop the accident before it is one.
Technology and Telematics

No more bulky, impossible-to-fold maps, and no more stopping to ask for directions. Just tell it where you want to go, and the voice activated integrated navigation system shows you the right way.

1986 Ferrari 328 GTS

- One of 6,068 328 GTS' Produced (1985-1989)
- Ordered New through Lake Forest Sportscars in Illinois
- Rosso Corsa over Black Leather
- Removable Targa Top
- 3.2L Mid Engine V8 with RWD
- 5 Speed Gated Manual Transmission
- All Stock, Unmodified Example minus the Stereo
- Original Window Sticker
- All Service History, Tools, and Books
- 27k Original Miles
The Ferrari 328 GTS represents one of the most iconic and usable classics to wear the Prancing Horse badge. Produced from 1985 through 1989, just 6,068 GTS examples left Maranello, making this 1986 model part of a limited and highly desirable production run. Widely regarded as the final evolution of the analog, small-displacement V8 Ferraris of the era, the 328 GTS blends timeless Pininfarina styling with mechanical simplicity and reliability that has made it a favorite among collectors and enthusiasts alike.Finished in traditional Rosso Corsa over Black leather, this example presents exactly as a classic Ferrari should. The removable targa top offers the best of both worldsopen-air driving with the structural feel of a coupe, allowing the driver to fully enjoy the soundtrack of the mid-mounted V8. Its stance, subtle side strakes, and signature pop-up headlights remain unmistakably 1980s Ferrari, yet the design has aged with remarkable grace.Power comes from a 3.2-liter, naturally aspirated V8 mounted mid-ship and paired to a 5-speed gated manual transmission. Delivering power to the rear wheels, the 328 GTS offers an engaging, analog driving experience defined by precise steering feel and the unmistakable click-clack of the exposed metal shift gate. With no driver aids and a lightweight chassis, it captures the pure mechanical character that modern supercars often lack.This particular car was ordered new through Lake Forest Sportscars in Illinois and remains an exceptionally original, unmodified example, retaining its factory specification aside from a stereo upgrade. With just 27,132 original miles, it has clearly been carefully preserved and enjoyed sparingly over the past four decades.Accompanying the vehicle are its original window sticker, full service history, books, and tools, an increasingly rare and valuable collection of documentation. For collectors seeking a highly original, low-mileage example of one of Ferrari's most beloved V8 models, this 1986 328 GTS represents an opportunity to own a benchmark of 1980s Italian performance and design.

description: The 1984 Porsche 911 Carrera Cabriolet represents one of the most iconic open-top sports cars of the air-cooled erablending timeless design, analog driving purity, and unmistakable Porsche character. Finished in stunning Slate Blue Metallic over a beautifully appointed Blue Leather interior , this example captures the elegance and sporting intent that defined the 3.2 Carrera generation. Under the rear decklid sits Porsches legendary 3.2-liter flat-six, delivering crisp throttle response and the unmistakable air-cooled soundtrack enthusiasts cherish. This Carrera is equipped with factory sport shock absorbers and the iconic 16-inch forged Fuchs alloy wheels in proper staggered fitment, giving it the ideal stance and balanced performance Porsche intended. Inside, the cabin is elevated with leather sport seats, a leather-wrapped steering wheel with hub extension, leather gear lever gaiter, factory cruise control, and a period-correct Blaupunkt Monterey cassette radiopreserving the authentic 1980s experience. Built to U.S. specification and thoughtfully optioned from new, this 911 has been maintained in exceptional condition and presents practically like a new car. The paint, interior, and overall fit and finish reflect remarkable care, making it increasingly difficult to find another example in this level of preservation. The Slate Blue Metallic over Blue Leather combination is both rare and strikingan elegant yet sporting specification that feels distinctly Porsche. As air-cooled 911 values continue to strengthen, a beautifully preserved 3.2 Carrera Cabriolet like this represents not only an extraordinary driving experience but also a compelling long-term collectible. A true classic from Stuttgarts golden eraready to be enjoyed with the top down.

Technology is front and center with Chevrolet Infotainment 3 Premium, integrated navigation, wireless Apple CarPlay and Android Auto, wireless device charging, HD Radio, SiriusXM capability, and a Bose Performance Series 14-speaker sound system. Black lug nuts and body-color accents complete the aggressive exterior presence.

Safety and driver confidence are equally impressive, featuring Side Blind Zone Alert, Rear Cross Traffic Alert, Rear Park Assist, rear parking sensors, and advanced theft deterrent systems including vehicle inclination and interior movement sensors. Four-wheel independent suspension, four-wheel disc brakes, and advanced stability and traction control systems ensure confident control at every speed.

Safety and Security
  • Forward collision mitigation - Forward thinking. You look away for just a second and suddenly the vehicle in front of you has stopped. That's when the forward collision mitigation system comes to life. When it senses an impending impact, it will activate a combination of features to help prevent or reduce the severity of an accident. Forward collision mitigation is always looking ahead.
  • Pedestrian impact prevention - An extra step toward safety. Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. It projects that image to an interior display screen, AND should an impact become likely, Pedestrian impact prevention takes steps to avoid a collision.
  • Hands-off cruise control - Set it and forget it. Road trips used to be stressful. Cruise control only managed speed, but not distance or safety. Now with hands-off cruise control simply set your desired speed and let sensor technology maintain a safe distance between you and surrounding vehicles with minimal steering input from you. It slows you down, speeds you up and even keeps you in your own lane. Meet your ultimate co-pilot with hands-off cruise control.
  • Rear camera - Watching your back! The rear camera helps you see obstacles and hazards you otherwise couldn't by showing enhanced images of what is behind you. The rear camera is an extra set of eyes that's both convenient and safe.

description: Just arrived is this exquisite, FACTORY FRESH, NO-ACCIDENT, ONE-OWNER, NONSMOKER, TURBOCHARGED 2023 Mercedes-Benz E 450 Cabriolet! RANKED #1 OUT OF 10 IN LUXURY MIDSIZE CARS BY U.S. NEWS & WORLD REPORT, this E-Class car boasts comfortable ride quality, a peppy engine, upscale interior, AND loads of standard features! As Edmunds says, ''The premium interior, smooth ride and excellent driver aids all come together in a handsome, well-crafted package.'' ''The E-Class is all about subtlety. The exterior design is handsome without being, and the interior is rather stunning. It all exudes luxury, and it feels like the class benchmark that it's been for the past few years,'' they go on to say. ''The E-Class nails the most important aspect of a luxury car: quiet refinement. The seats offer lots of support and adjustment . . . They remained comfortable after a few hundred miles behind the wheel. The ride is smooth and isolating without feeling overly disconnected. '' The Insurance Institute for Highway Safety named the 2023 Mercedes-Benz E-Class a TOP SAFETY PICK+, the organization's highest award. The E-Class earned the highest rating of Good in all six crash tests! The National Highway Traffic Safety Administration gave the E-Class an overall safety rating of five out of five stars, with five stars in the frontal crash, side crash and rollover tests. Its nine-speed transmission offers the ultimate balance between fuel efficiency and performance. It saves gasoline while ensuring the smoothest operation. With its odometer now reading 7,312, it is STILL COVERED under the balance of the New Vehicle Limited Warranty warranties until August 2028 or 50,000 miles (whichever occurs first)! Its 362 horsepower is more appropriate for a car of this size than the E 350's 255 hp, and it all in all comes standard with all-wheel drive. Among the E-Class' available options, the Driver Assistance package is a near-must as it adds expected luxury car features such as adaptive cruise control and lane keeping assistance,'' Edmunds recommends.   • Forward collision mitigation - Forward thinking. You look away for just a second and suddenly the vehicle in front of you has stopped. That's when the forward collision mitigation system comes to life. When it senses an impending impact, it will activate a combination of features to help prevent or reduce the severity of an accident. Forward collision mitigation is always looking ahead.
  • Pedestrian impact prevention - An extra step toward safety. Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. It projects that image to an interior display screen, AND should an impact become likely, Pedestrian impact prevention takes steps to avoid a collision.
  • Hands-off cruise control - Set it and forget it. Road trips used to be stressful. Cruise control only managed speed, but not distance or safety. Now with hands-off cruise control simply set your desired speed and let sensor technology maintain a safe distance between you and surrounding vehicles with minimal steering input from you. It slows you down, speeds you up and even keeps you in your own lane. Meet your ultimate co-pilot with hands-off cruise control.

Inside, the cabin is a sanctuary of luxury, featuring high-quality leather upholstery, real wood trim, and a well-designed dashboard. Modern conveniences, such as a premium sound system and climate control, ensure a comfortable ride, making it suitable for both leisurely drives and long journeys.Driving the 1996 XJS is an experience that emphasizes Jaguar's commitment to craftsmanship. The car features a refined suspension system that smooths out imperfections in the road, providing a comfortable ride while maintaining agile handling. The precise steering and balanced weight distribution contribute to a confident driving experience, whether navigating city streets or cruising along the coast.Historically, the XJS has become a classic symbol of Jaguar's engineering prowess. The 1996 model not only showcases the brand's evolution but also stands out as a reliable and enjoyable vehicle that combines heritage with modernity.   • Forward collision mitigation - Forward thinking. You look away for just a second and suddenly the vehicle in front of you has stopped. When it senses an impending impact, it will activate a combination of features to help prevent or reduce the severity of an accident. Forward collision mitigation is always looking ahead.
  • Pedestrian impact prevention - An extra step toward safety. Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. It projects that image to an interior display screen, AND should an impact become likely, Pedestrian impact prevention takes steps to avoid a collision.

This Mercedes is a fantastic car for the price and includes every option offered in this car.
